label: Analytics link
type: the supertype of the three Analytics link kinds (analytics:local-link, analytics:remote-link, and an external-link kind never itself promoted) - a connection from an Analytics scope to a data source. Created/edited/listed via couchbase-cli analytics-link-setup or enterprise-analytics-link-setup.
evidence: In Analytics, a link represents a connection to a data source.
note: "NARRATED AS PROMOTED, NEVER ACTUALLY FILED" - the recurring defect this project keeps re-discovering, found again here: analytics:remote-link and analytics:local-link have BOTH carried isSubtypeOf: analytics:analytics-link since round 21, and this round's two couchbase-cli link-setup pages added two more references, for a real whole-corpus recurrence of 4 - but no concepts/analytics/analytics-link.json file existed until now.
relates_to_competency_question: What is the common supertype of local, remote and external Analytics links?
